reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: Section 9.4 limits Customer's exposure on convenience termination to Fees for conforming Services delivered plus a refund of prepaid Fees, with no termination charge, acceleration or minimum fee; Section 27.3 expressly allows force-majeure termination 'without penalty'.

No liquidated damages, penalty or Customer-payable early-termination fee language appears in the cited or referenced provisions, so the clause set meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable LD).

The Section 2.1 take-or-pay is correctly characterised as a volume/minimum-commitment term rather than liquidated damages, and the rationale properly invokes the no-double-flagging instruction; it is also not walk-away territory under this rule (not framed as LD and not exceeding remaining contract value).
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged; deterministic checks flagged nothing.
